blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trisha Tubu sustained her fine form to send Farm Fresh to the solo second place after ousting Capital1, 25-17, 25-21, 23-25, 25-23, for their third straight win in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday night at Philsports Arena. Tubu unleashed 25 points, all from kills out of 54 attempts, as the Foxiees improve to a 5-2 record behind unbeaten No. 1 team Nxled (6-0). With three straight victories, Farm Fresh has a chance to seal the semifinals berth and a twice-to-beat advantage when it faces defending champion Creamline, which lost two straight games with a […]...
